card.name: Hyphens and URL colons in labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation that joins parts of a term in drug-label text: the hyphen after a prefix (mono-, non-, veno-, long-) and the :// after http in FDA test web links.

modes.label: Hyphen after prefix
modes.description: A hyphen right after a short prefix, where a second word part follows.

modes.label: Web link start
modes.description: The :// after http in a link to FDA companion diagnostics tests.
modes.example: Information on FDA-approved tests for the detection of genetic mutations is available at http<<://>>www.fda.gov/companiondiagnostics

card.plain: It fires on the hyphen inside compound terms and on the start of web addresses in label text.
